# Dialling in espresso

Start with 18 g of coffee in and 36 g of liquid out in 28 seconds. If the shot runs fast and tastes sour, grind finer. If
it is slow and bitter, grind coarser. Use water around 93 C and preheat the portafilter. Stale beans give thin shots and no
crema, so use beans within a month of roasting.
